FAKE ASSESSMENT MANUAL — CHAPTER X: ENVIRONMENTAL OBSERVATIONS
(Synthetic test document for the Fogbell pipeline. Not a real regulatory text.)

Section X covers environmental observation items recorded by lighthouse keepers.

X0100: Fog Visibility Check
Intent: To record whether the keeper performed a fog visibility check during
the observation period. Visibility checks inform the decision to sound the bell.

Item Rationale
Unchecked visibility is the leading cause of unwarned approaches.

Page X-1
X0100: Fog Visibility Check (continued)

Steps for Assessment
1. Review the keeper's log for the 7-day look-back period ending on the ARD.
   Look back over the 7-day period ending on the ARD; the ARD is included in
   the look-back period.
2. Determine whether at least one visibility check was performed and documented.

Coding Instructions
Code 0, visibility not checked: no fog visibility check was performed during
   the look-back period.
Code 1, visibility checked: at least one fog visibility check was performed
   during the look-back period.

Coding Tips
- Code 1 only if a visibility check was performed and documented within the
  look-back period. Undocumented checks may not be coded.

Page X-2
X0100: Fog Visibility Check (continued)

Coding Tips (continued)
- Checks performed prior to admission are not coded.
- Checks on the day of assessment are excluded.

Supporting Documentation
The keeper's log must contain a dated, signed entry recording the visibility
check and the reading obtained. Entries without a reading do not support Code 1.

X0200: Bell Sounding Frequency
Intent: To record how often the bell was sounded. (Out of scope for this test.)
